title: The Night Desk
about: Cast proof: five presenters, three skins, one programme clock. Each segment is one cast member in their own studio skin; the director cuts inside each segment, the segments hard-cut into each other.

lines.text: Good evening, and welcome to the night desk. Tonight the whole team is in, and every one of us brought a story.
Out past the moon, a tiny probe has just woken up after eleven years asleep. Nobody expected that!

story.title: River crews work through the night

lines.text: Closer to home, the river is rising again. Crews are working through the night, and they are asking for volunteers.
The markets, meanwhile, were flat. Very flat. I checked twice, and they were still flat.
And that is the desk for tonight. Be kind to someone tomorrow. Goodnight!
